title: Stack/Quotes
summary:
"Huntik Foundation what are they doing here?"
- Stack to Wilder (Doorway to Huntik)

"We will get them Mr Wilder then the whole Organization will look to you."
- Stack to Wilder (Doorway to Huntik)

"No more, Mr.Wilder will finish them."
- Stack to his Titan, Dark Dryad

"Come on old man hit them while they are distracted."
- Stack to Hoffman (Doorway to Huntik)

"Wait there is an inscription on the ceiling, He who dares invade my sanctuary will be forever doomed, Its the
prophecy Nostradamus gave on his death pit."
- Stack to Wilder and Hoffman (The Tower of Nostradamus)

"Something is wrong Mr Wilder this place is full with ancient trash but nothing magical."
- Stack to Wilder (The Tower of Nostradamus)

"When do we make our move sir?"- Stack to Wilder (Cave of the Casterwills)

"So these Foundation brats are after Void are they, Hmm it must be special."
- Stack to Wilder (Chasing Void)

"Quiet down or i will Quiet you."
- Stack to Lok and Sophie (Chasing Void)

"Get your Titans out already, Destroy them!"
- Stack to his Suits (Chasing Void)

"You have won this battle Dante Vale but you will never get to Void before us."
- Stack to Dante Vale (Chasing Void)

"We've been waiting for you. How do you like Dark Dryad's trap?"
- Stack to Dante Vale (The Blood Spiral)

"Don't worry Mr Kiel, I will capture Medusa for you i won't need help."(Stack)

"Do i look like a Mister to you."(Kiel)

"Just Kiel then."(Stack) (Zhalia's Mission)

"I know what you're thinking, no Seeker have successfully tame Medusa in two thousand years!"
- Stack to Kiel about Medusa (Zhalia's Mission)

"Time for my secret weapon, only a magic mirror can beat Medusa."
- Stack to kiel (Zhalia's Mission)

"Heh, I hope he can take care of himself!"
- Stack to Kiel (Zhalia's Mission)

"That was too close."
- Stack to kiel (Zhalia's Mission)
